# Heterogeneous spatial Biomass_core reference

Captured from `scripts/landis_heterogeneous_reference.R` on 2026-11-14.

- R 4.3.3
- LandR 1.2.0.9064
- SpaDES.core 3.2.1.9067
- Biomass_core commit `21b3392324c2787a47751be808cbf9e595f308c0`
- 20 × 20 landscape at 100 m, 400 pixels
- four pixel groups, two species per group
- ages 10–100, initial B 500–5000 g/m²
- fixed seed `20261114`

The run is a small heterogeneous reference, not a regional LBSE reproduction.
